result.description: Payments platform: accept payments, billing/subscriptions, payouts, Connect marketplaces, and related financial infrastructure via API.
result.auth_detail: Secret/restricted API keys sent as HTTP Basic username or Bearer token. OAuth2 for Connect platforms (connect.stripe.com/oauth/authorize) and for MCP server; agent API keys also supported for MCP.
result.access_detail: Sign up free; sandbox/test keys available immediately, live keys after account activation. No setup or monthly fees, pay per transaction. Connect OAuth requires registering a Connect platform (self-serve, with Stripe account review for live use).
result.api_notes: REST, form-encoded requests, JSON responses. Covers payments, customers, subscriptions, invoices, products/prices, payouts, refunds, disputes, Connect, Issuing, Treasury, Tax, Radar, webhooks etc. (hundreds of endpoints). Official SDKs in many languages.

evidence.quote: Provide your API key as the basic auth username value. You don’t need to provide a password.
